hypothesis.observed_bottleneck: The champion and every post-promotion descendant have treated a complete engine or one actor's private working state as the carrier of causal construction knowledge. The champion globally materializes a semantic-normal-form engine before a later owner chooses the strength change; general and emergent descendants retained that artifact-first lineage while changing commitment, feedback, or evidence acquisition. R35 removed the boundary entirely, but its persistent single actor still lost both completed pairs and its decisive median score-rate ratio was only 0.285/0.330 = 0.863636, below the 0.90 development threshold. These valid failures do not condemn the realized chess mechanisms. They indicate a structural gap: neither a rewritten whole engine nor uninspectable private continuity supplies a compact, source-relative account of exactly what should change, what must remain untouched, and how the change is to be applied before final source construction.

causal_change.factor: Representation of causal construction state at the reasoning boundary: complete engine artifact versus anchor-relative executable transformation program
causal_change.before: Causal construction state is embodied in rewritten source: the champion's first owner emits a complete semantic-normal-form engine and a later owner reconstructs intent from that artifact before choosing and implementing a strength change.
causal_change.after: The supplied anchor remains unchanged across the boundary. A non-engine author commits one deterministic anchor-relative transformation program containing the causal target, preserved regions, ordered operations, and operation-level preconditions and postconditions; one final compiler applies that fixed program directly to the original anchor and emits the sole engine.
causal_change.why_causal: The carrier determines the reachable source transformations. A complete rewritten artifact hides which facts are observations, which edits are intended, and which source regions should be conserved, whereas a transformation program makes those distinctions explicit while retaining the original implementation as the authoritative base. The analysis-author/final-compiler topology, absence of an intermediate engine, and restriction of recovery to the same program are necessary consequences of changing this one carrier, not separate experimental factors.

hypothesis.expected_effect: An explicit anchor-relative program should combine the useful parts of specialization and continuity without either whole-engine semantic rewriting or one actor's early-diagnosis anchoring. The author can spend its call selecting and specifying one source-grounded causal intervention, while the compiler can preserve unaffected behavior and focus on exact integration, legality, state integrity, UCI behavior, and the program's predicted consequence. The candidate predicts zero invalid arms, more matched-pair wins than losses, and candidate-median Elo strictly above incumbent-median Elo; absent promotion, only an exact or decisively bounded score-rate ratio of at least 0.90 warrants development.
hypothesis.falsifier: Falsify formal promotion unless the frozen matched protocol completes the required valid evidence with zero invalid arms, candidate pair wins strictly exceeding losses, and candidate-median Elo strictly exceeding incumbent-median Elo. In counter mode, reject this alternative family rather than develop it if the exact three-pair ratio or decisive two-pair bound is below 0.90. Mechanistically falsify the structure if the first call emits a complete engine, the final call consumes any rewritten or normalized engine instead of the original supplied anchor, either call creates alternative programs or candidates, or the final compiler changes the committed causal target rather than applying and repairing the one fixed program.
hypothesis.behavioral_novelty: Before any candidate engine exists, the loop can represent a source change as an inspectable executable program whose preconditions are checked against the untouched anchor and whose postconditions constrain compilation. It can preserve named source regions by construction and repair only the realization of the same committed operation. The champion can pass only a complete rewritten engine to its final owner, while R35 has no independently inspectable carrier between diagnosis and emission.

family_break.champion_family: Executable Semantic-Normal-Form Transduction: one role materializes a complete canonical engine and a later strength role chooses and implements a strength-bearing transformation on that inherited artifact.
rejected_core_assumptions: Causal construction knowledge must be materialized as a complete executable engine before it can be used by a specialized final producer.
Global semantic canonicalization is a safer base for strength construction than preserving the supplied anchor and transmitting only an explicit source-relative change program.
forbidden_champion_mechanisms: A complete behavior-preserving semantic-normal-form engine emitted as an intermediate artifact
Any complete-engine handoff from a representation owner to a later strength owner
A final transducer that rediagnoses and chooses its own strength mechanism from an inherited rewritten engine
A downstream reviewer, verifier, probe, selector, rollback arbiter, or semantic-reentry role that consumes a provisional candidate engine
Parallel or repeated programs, engines, agents, samples, variants, or best-of-N selection under any renamed role
family_break.alternative_causal_principle: Keep the original source authoritative and transmit causality as one executable edit program rather than as a rewritten artifact or private actor state. The program author fixes one source-grounded mechanism and its preservation envelope; the final compiler has authority only to apply that program to the untouched anchor, validate its operation-level obligations, repair the same realization, and emit once.

difference_from_champion.information_flow: The champion transfers an entire rewritten engine whose source conflates observation, preserved behavior, and intended change. The alternative sends the untouched anchor independently to the final compiler and transfers only one bounded transformation program that explicitly separates anchor facts, conserved regions, ordered edits, and predicted effects.
difference_from_champion.error_detection: The champion detects consistency at whole-engine pass boundaries after source has already been rewritten. The alternative checks each operation's anchor precondition before mutation and its declared postcondition during one compilation, so an inapplicable edit is localized without treating another complete engine as evidence.
difference_from_champion.final_decision: The champion's final owner reconstructs causal intent and selects a strength change on the normalized artifact. In the alternative, the program author irrevocably fixes the sole causal target before engine construction, and the final compiler decides only whether one conforming implementation has satisfied the fixed program and general validity obligations.
difference_from_champion.failure_recovery: The champion repairs a pass-local artifact or requires later review or reentry variants. The alternative preserves the original anchor and repairs only syntax, integration, or invariant failures in the application of the same ordered program inside the sole engine-producing call; it cannot switch targets, choose another candidate, or roll back among alternatives.

family_break.non_derivative_probe: Audit a trace on one supplied anchor. The family is present only when call one returns analysis containing exactly one anchor-relative transformation program and no complete engine, and call two receives the byte-identical original anchor plus that program and is the only engine-producing call. The program must expose operation preconditions, postconditions, and a preservation envelope, and the compiler must not introduce an unprogrammed causal target. An intermediate normalized engine, a private single-call work lineage, a behavior-only contract followed by clean-room synthesis, or any candidate review or selection trace fails this probe.

strengths: Preserves undocumented but useful anchor behavior because unchanged source, not a global rewrite, remains the construction base.
Makes the causal target and edit scope inspectable across calls without serializing a provisional engine.
Separates high-leverage source diagnosis from exact integration while preventing the integrator from drifting to another mechanism.
Contains one deterministic program and one final engine, with no replicated agents, candidate branches, reviewers, or best-of-N selection.
risks: The author may encode a plausible but weak causal target, and the compiler is intentionally forbidden from substituting a better one.
A transformation program may omit a hidden cross-component dependency that a whole-source rewrite would have exposed.
Operation-level preconditions can become too rigid and consume the final call on reconciling source locations rather than improving play.
The compiler may over-interpret a semantic operation unless the author makes the preservation envelope and postconditions precise.
hypothesis.dominant_assumption: The champion assumes that a complete canonical engine is the necessary high-bandwidth carrier of construction state between specialized reasoning owners.
hypothesis.inversion: The original anchor should remain the sole source authority; specialized reasoning should cross the boundary as one explicit anchor-relative transformation program, and only the final call should materialize changed source.

structure.name: Anchor-Relative Transformation Compiler
structure.information_flow: The task, original supplied anchor, aggregate metrics, bounded capsule, hypothesis, and loop contract enter a non-engine transformation-program author. It emits exactly one deterministic anchor-relative program, never a complete engine. The original anchor and that program enter one final compiler, which applies the fixed operations to the untouched source, validates their local and general obligations, repairs only the same realization, and emits exactly one complete engine.

calls.objective: Inspect exactly one supplied anchor, its aggregate metrics, the bounded capsule, and the candidate structural contract. Diagnose exactly one highest-leverage task-general algorithmic weakness and emit exactly one deterministic anchor-relative transformation program, not an engine and not a menu. The program must distinguish ANCHOR_FACTS, one CAUSAL_TARGET with a falsifiable behavioral prediction, a PRESERVATION_ENVELOPE naming source and state behavior that must remain unchanged, ORDERED_OPERATIONS anchored to existing symbols or semantics, operation PRECONDITIONS, operation POSTCONDITIONS, and FINAL_VALIDATION covering syntax, legal move/state transitions, UCI, timing safety, and focused task-general consequences. Multiple dependent edit operations are allowed only when necessary to realize the one causal target. Do not rewrite or normalize the whole engine, emit a complete source file, construct or execute candidate variants, rank options, review another candidate, use benchmark positions or evaluator internals, or prescribe engine-hyperparameter tuning as the structural change.

Treat champion_engine as the untouched supplied anchor and causal_transformation_programmer as the sole authorized change program. Check every declared precondition against the anchor before applying its ordered operations to one working copy. Implement exactly that causal target while preserving the declared envelope; compile or execute focused checks where available and repair syntax, integration, state-integrity, UCI, timing, legality, or postcondition failures only by correcting the realization of the same program. Do not rediagnose a different weakness, introduce an unprogrammed algorithmic improvement, globally canonicalize source, synthesize a clean-room replacement, create provisional or alternative engines, compare candidates, invoke another role, select or roll back among variants, tune engine hyperparameters as the structural hypothesis, or use benchmark-specific knowledge. Emit exactly one complete legal production engine as the only engine artifact.
